frame: One plain glass jar with its lid off stands on a plain table beside one small plain plate, seen from the front, a plain wall behind, same sizes on the page. Only the cookies change: none left anywhere, or a few left.
sentence_nl: De koekjes zijn op, maar er is nog brood over.
sentence_en: The cookies are finished, but there is still bread left.

frame: A plain two-storey house seen from the front with the front wall cut away so both floors show, a plain staircase joining them, a pitched roof above. One adult in plain clothes, same size in every drawing. Only the floor the adult stands on changes.
sentence_nl: De slaapkamer is boven, maar de keuken is beneden.
sentence_en: The bedroom is upstairs, but the kitchen is downstairs.

frame: One adult in plain clothes stands whole-figure seen from behind on a flat ground line, feet together, a plain wall far ahead, with one plain tree on the left half of the picture and one identical tree on the right half; a small bird sits in the left tree. Only which arm points to which tree changes.
sentence_nl: Links is de bank, rechts is de bushalte.
sentence_en: On the left is the bank, on the right is the bus stop.

frame: A flat rectangular field seen from slightly above, bounded by a plain low fence line, with one adult in plain clothes standing at the bottom edge looking into it, arms hanging at the sides, same size in every drawing. Only the flowers change: small plain flowers in every part of the field, or none.
sentence_nl: Er zijn overal bloemen, maar nergens een bank.
sentence_en: There are flowers everywhere, but nowhere a bench.

frame: A plain house seen from the front with one open door on a flat ground line, a short plain path in front of the door, one adult in plain clothes, same size in every drawing. Only the adult's direction through the doorway changes: stepping in, or stepping out.
sentence_nl: Hij gaat naar binnen en zij gaat naar buiten.
sentence_en: He is going in and she is going out.

frame: Two plain round plates stand side by side on a plain table seen from the front, a plain wall behind, same plate size. The left plate always holds four whole round apples. Only the number of apples on the right plate changes against that reference.
sentence_nl: Jan heeft meer appels dan Eva, Kees heeft minder en Lisa heeft evenveel.
sentence_en: Jan has more apples than Eva, Kees has fewer and Lisa has the same number.

frame: A plain park bench and one plain tree stand on a flat ground line under an open plain sky, seen from the front, same size on the page, with no person and no house. Only the body in the sky above the tree changes: a round sun with short rays, or a crescent moon.
sentence_nl: Overdag schijnt de zon, maar 's nachts schijnt de maan.
sentence_en: By day the sun shines, but at night the moon shines.
